name: Push Box
description: The first clip shrinks into a box, the box is pushed out by a box of the second clip, which then grows to fill the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the clips move: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down

params.name: box
params.description: Box size relative to the frame
